one_liner: Reducto is a document parsing/extraction API with a free tier ($150 credits), self-serve API keys, bearer auth, and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: Static API key created in Studio and sent as Authorization: Bearer. Workload identity (OIDC federated tokens) is also described in a blog post, but no OAuth2 app flow for third-party multi-user access was found.
access_notes: Free Studio account with no credit card gives an API key and $150 in free credits. Standard is pay-as-you-go after that.
blocker_notes: No blocker. Each user supplies their own API key, since there is no OAuth.

evidence.quote: For direct REST calls, pass it as a Bearer token
In the Studio sidebar, click **API Keys**, then **Create API Key**. Give it a name and copy the key.
Parse API - Extract API - Edit API - Split API
The Reducto MCP server connects AI agents directly to Reducto.
